properties.Description: Starting point of violence of the troubles, currently sight of visual memory

properties.Name: Welcome to Sandy Row Mural

properties.Deep Dive: Vertical to community beliefs and horizontal to British government

properties.label: Bobby Sands Mural - 49 Falls Rd, Belfast, BT12 4PD, United Kingdom
properties.Name: Bobby Sands Mural
properties.Description: Visual memorial of prominent Irish Republican hunger striker. Shows narrative of importance of visual memory in upholding community divides.

properties.label: Raidio Failte (Irish Speaking Radio)
properties.Name: Raidio Failte Building Murals
properties.Description: "Gateway" to the majority Catholic area of West Belfast from City Centre. Prominent sight of murals that connect community belifs to wider, international political narratives.

properties.label: Peace Gates Belfast - 97 Lanark Way, Belfast, BT13 3BJ, United Kingdom
properties.Name: Peace Gates
properties.Description: Sight of highly muralised gates that still close at nigth, serving as a barrier between the Catholic and Protestan communities. The in between area is meant to serve as a compltely neutral buffer zone, with murals focusing on ideas of global peace and community healing.

properties.label: Falls Road International Wall
properties.Name: Solidarity Wall
properties.Description: Peace wall/line that shows solidarity for international social and political movements. Shows Catholic communities feeling of connection to people with struggles similar to them

properties.label: Bayadoro Pub Memorial
properties.Name: Bayadoro Pub Memorial Garden
properties.Description: Collection of murals and images memorializing Protestant lives lost at the hands of the IRA throughout the Troubles and by "Sinn Fein" in more recent history

properties.label: Peacewall
properties.Name: Peacewall
properties.Description: One of the peacewalls serving as a physcial reminder of sectarian division and violence that still stands in Belfast today. These walls and the meaning they hold in Belfast communities have shifted from necessary boundaries to offset physical violence towards spaces for visual expression trhough muralism and graffiti.

properties.label: East Side Gallery Berlin
properties.Name: East Side Gallery Berlin
properties.Description: Museum in which pieces of the Berlin Wall and conflict visulization narratives on pieces of this wall are housed. The wall has now been taken down and so the physical barrier between East and West Berlin no longer exists, but cultural violence and conflict still persists in ways similar to the post-conflict state of Belfast.
